caption:
Be delusionally optimistic AND let your actions follow your beliefs.

Don’t just sit on a beach all day, waiting for luck to hit you.

This is a no-bs zone - welcome to my page:

@tim_denning
author: Tim Denning
title: The Science Behind Delusional Optimism
one_liner: Your brain finds what you tell it to find, so assuming the best literally makes it happen.
key_points: The brain is a prediction machine — it surfaces evidence matching whatever belief you feed it
Optimists don't avoid failure; they recover faster, retry sooner, and compound better outcomes over decades
Reframing is everything: rejection becomes redirection, failure becomes data, bad days become setups
This isn't magical thinking — it's a logical feedback loop grounded in behavioral science
